verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5080 page documents a ninth-gen NVENC hardware encoder for fast video exports and claims acceleration for video editing, 3D rendering, graphic design, and optimized ComfyUI creative workflows. It does not name specific codecs (AV1/HEVC), list supported creator apps, or mention Studio or ISV-certified driver support, so only roughly half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encode/decode documentation, named creator-app acceleration details, Studio/ISV-certified driver documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of media-engine performance.
